route_differences: Source indices start at 1; book indices start at 0 with explicit natural-to-real embedding.
Source decreasing monotone proof and k_j >= j are left as exercises; book must prove both fully.
Source main BW uses limsup; interval-bisection alternative uses shrinking intervals and geometric lengths. Neither apparatus is assumed in this bounded batch.
Source explicitly presents peak idea as a challenging exercise at 2530s; no complete selection proof there. Book independently supplies least-natural-element deterministic total update functions.
Tail peaks are partitioned by natural-index unboundedness versus its exact negation, avoiding unproved cardinality/choice assertions.
Source bounded infinite set accumulation theorem selection hint not imported; only sequence BW is planned.
Source bounded convergent-subsequence criterion is stated without proof; book uses explicit bad-index recursion and composition.
Cauchy passages actually read for future boundary only; no Cauchy theorem claimed proved here. Future route uses BW plus one convergent subsequence, not source limsup/liminf.
